title: api-config-shape-scratchpad
content:
Quick notes: API config shape for per-route inference settings.

Goals:
- expose model selection + version pinning
- per-route batching and cache hints
- routing policy (latency/cost/region) + fallbacks
- allow rollout/canary flags and priority levels

Open questions:
- Should batching params be per-request override or locked per-route by default? pros/cons for each.
- How to express multi-tier fallback lists with constraints (cost cap, max-latency)?
- Validation surface: when do we reject invalid model ids vs convert to closest compatible variant?

Sketch (example shape):
{
  "route": "/chat/completions",
  "model": "redwood/7b-chat@v2",
  "max_tokens": 512,
  "priority": "normal",
  "batching": {"enabled": true, "max_batch_size": 8, "timeout_ms": 20},
  "kv_cache": {"enabled": true, "ttl_seconds": 3600},
  "routing_policy": "latency-first",
  "fallback": ["redwood/3b-chat-quant@v1"]
}

Notes to self:
- integrate with rollout policies (canary_percent, start_time/end_time)
- map "priority" to routing tiers (dedicated vs hosted vs best-effort)
- need schema for: model id format, version pinning, allowed fallback families, numeric bounds for batching/timeouts
- think about UI: simple toggles for common cases, advanced JSON for power users

Immediate TODOs:
- sync spec with product-hosted-api doc PROJ-987 (owner: Jamie)
- ask SRE (Samir) about safe default timeout_ms for batching across GPU types
- draft JSON Schema + basic validation tests (unit + integration)

Links:
- Jira: PROJ-987
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/342
- Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/1234567

Notes: informal; lots of TODOs and open questions. Keep this as scratchpad until we align with product and SRE.
summary: Personal scratchpad: initial design for per-route API config shape (batching, routing, fallback, cache). Includes example JSON and TODOs to sync with product and SRE.
